counties.name: Orange County
counties.notes: Official search is OC FastTrack (browser session). Verified 2026-11-11: the county ArcGIS services publish no building-permit layer — no public feed exists.

counties.name: Osceola County
counties.notes: Accela Citizen Access; needs a browser session (ASP.NET viewstate). County ArcGIS feed (New_Construction_P_Permits) lists permits but has NO contractor/builder or phone field, so builder names still require the portal.

counties.name: Seminole County
counties.notes: Verified 2026-11-11: permitting moved to Accela OneStop (live Oct 19, 2026), account + PIN based; no public permit feed exists.

counties.name: Lake County
counties.vendor: OpenGov (moved from Accela Mar 3, 2025); county Permit Activity Reports (ASP.NET)
counties.notes: Verified 2026-11-11: permitting moved to OpenGov (Mar 3, 2025) with no public record-search API; the county HTML activity reports are the only public route.

counties.name: Volusia County
counties.notes: Verified 2026-11-11: Connect Live / AMANDA portal is UI-only; no public machine-readable permit feed with builder names exists.

counties.name: Brevard County
counties.notes: Official public search is Accela (Brevard's Advanced Service Site). Requires a browser session. Verified 2026-11-11: county GIS services carry no permit layer — no open-data API exists.

counties.name: Sumter County
counties.notes: Verified 2026-11-11: CitizenServe reports are interactive HTML only; no public JSON feed.

counties.name: Polk County
counties.notes: Verified 2026-11-11: Accela is the only search route; no public permit feed exists.

counties.name: Hernando County
counties.notes: EnerGov adapter exists; not enabled until a live pull is verified.

counties.name: Charlotte County
counties.notes: Always included (SW Florida). Accela Citizen Access; needs a browser session.
